dataList.data: Loops allow you to execute a block of code repeatedly. Python provides for and while loops for iteration.
List comprehensions provide a concise way to create lists.

# Create a list of squares
squares = [x**2 for x in range(10)]
print(squares)  # [0, 1, 4, 9, 16, 25, 36, 49, 64, 81]

# With condition
even_squares = [x**2 for x in range(10) if x % 2 == 0]
print(even_squares)  # [0, 4, 16, 36, 64]
Loops are essential for processing collections and performing repetitive tasks in Python.
